'''January 2001 Fairmont tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fairmont, West Virginia on 27 January 2001. It is known from Emerson Sklar's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1672">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-fairmont-west-virginia-1-27-01d1672/ fairmont-west-virginia-1-27-01], DeckTech (Emerson "Sparkz" Sklar, 27 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-fairmont-west-virginia-1-27-01d1672/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Fairmont, West Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
